surface_mechanism_description: Ligand exchange between NbCl5 and surface hydroxyl groups followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites.
evidence: The dominant Reaction 1 would effectively imply etching of Nb2O5 with NbCl5 vapor. It has also been demonstrated that a 100 nm thick film of Nb2O5 completely disappears during 4000 NbCl5 pulses of 0.5 s duration each, so etching really does take place. The removal of the product of Reaction 1 from the system is considered to explain why, in an ALD reactor, that reaction would occur instead of Reaction 2.
